# OCP MCP Server — Journey Guides

Call `read_guide(name=...)` with one of the names below to get step-by-step
tool sequences for common workflows.

| name                  | When to use it                                                       |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| build_concierge_app   | You want to create a new Orchestrator app with a Concierge agent.    |
| add_knowledge         | You have an existing agent and want to give it FAQ/knowledge.        |
| test_and_improve      | You have a deployed agent and want to test it and iterate.           |

Call `read_guide()` with no arguments to get this index.
